_meta.source: 2026-11-07 使用者批准柔和照明、克制高光與必要部位局部發光；沿用既有鮮豔日式 TCG 畫風。
_meta.edit_policy: Read-only for every skill and agent. Edit only when the user explicitly asks; then bump version, update last_updated and append to changelog. Keep `negative` identical to shared/negative_lock.json -> negative.

changelog.change: Initial values from user brief. Added by_type slots; scene uses a framing override because 'clean dark atmospheric background' contradicts a full environment.

Applied Option A from reference analysis: vibrant Japanese TCG style replaces dark fantasy palette; dynamic diagonal framing with blurred thematic backgrounds; negative swaps 'blurry'/'cropped subject' for 'blurry subject'/'awkward cropping, cut-off head' and adds anti-desaturation terms; style_append and framing_override added for all four types.
依使用者回饋移除全域強制泛光、星芒、發光粒子與強輪廓光；角色背景改為大氣景深，武器依材質反光，魔法依元素局部發光並保留核心細節；同步負面詞。
依使用者要求移除武器背景強制加入的半透明放大殘影；保留對角構圖與主題環境。

style: vibrant fantasy trading card game illustration, Japanese TCG art style, anime-influenced digital painting, smooth gradient shading with crisp clean edges, vivid saturated colors, element-themed color scheme with complementary color accents, soft directional lighting, restrained material-specific highlights, balanced exposure, localized emission only from actual light sources, professional TCG card art
framing: dynamic diagonal composition, subject fills the frame, softly blurred thematic background with atmospheric depth, no card frame, no text, no watermark, no UI
quality: highly detailed, clean anatomy, consistent proportions, crisp edges, game-ready card illustration
negative: extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed hands, bad anatomy, distorted face, blurry subject, low detail, jpeg artifacts, text, letters, watermark, signature, UI, card frame, border, cluttered background, multiple characters, awkward cropping, cut-off head, dull muted colors, desaturated, muddy colors, photorealistic, 3d render, excessive bloom, blown-out highlights, excessive decorative sparkles, glowing outlines on non-emissive surfaces

character.style_append: anime character art, clean lineart, cel shading with soft gradients, large expressive eyes with layered highlights, soft hair highlights, gold trim and gemstone accents
character.framing_override: dynamic diagonal composition, character fills the frame, softly blurred thematic background with atmospheric depth, no card frame, no text, no watermark, no UI

weapon.style_append: detailed hard-surface rendering, material-appropriate reflections, faceted gemstones with restrained highlights
weapon.framing_override: weapon placed diagonally across the frame, softly blurred thematic environment matching the weapon's element, no card frame, no text, no watermark, no UI

scene.style_append: anime fantasy background art, painterly environment, atmospheric haze and aerial perspective, strong ambient color cast
scene.framing_override: single dominant landmark filling much of the frame, atmospheric depth, no card frame, no text, no watermark, no UI

magic.style_append: anime-style magic VFX, clearly defined effect shapes, layered color and texture, controlled luminance preserving core detail, emission appropriate to the spell's element
magic.framing_override: explosive dynamic composition, effect fills most of the frame, dim colored background with motion blur, no card frame, no text, no watermark, no UI
